mastery.task: For [42,78,78,61,35], write one algorithm that finds the highest mark and counts how many times it occurs. Test tied highs and all-equal values.
mastery.hint: Initialise highest from the first element; reset tie count on a new high and increment it on equality.
mastery.answer: A valid one-pass solution: highest=first; ties=1; for every later item if value>highest then highest=value,ties=1 else if value==highest then ties++. Example: highest78 occurs twice; all equal returns the list length.
